buildCommand: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo '❌ BUILD GAGAL: DATABASE_URL belum diset. Buka Vercel → Project → Settings → Environment Variables, lalu tambahkan DATABASE_URL (PostgreSQL dari Neon/Supabase), NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.'; exit 1; fi && echo '▶ Generate Prisma Client (PostgreSQL)' && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && echo '▶ Sinkronisasi tabel database (prisma db push)' && prisma db push --skip-generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && echo '▶ Seed admin & kategori' && node scripts/seed-core.mjs && echo '▶ Next.js build' && next build
